_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::beam_interaction#1. The claim that the penalty parameter has a too-high and a too-low failure mode holds; its Signal did not. No condition-number printout appears anywhere (CONDITION_NUMBER_PRINTOUTS=0) and no post-processing of beam-beam distance is needed. On the upstream twobeamstwisting deck, dividing BEAMS_BTBLINEPENALTYPARAM by 1e4 lets the solve CONVERGE to a silently wrong answer — node 5 dispx 4.38e-6 against an expected -1.90e-2, contact simply not enforced — while multiplying by 1e8 makes NOX abort with 'The nonlinear solver did not converge!' from solver_nonlin_nox/4C_solver_nonlin_nox_problem.cpp before any result test runs. Under-penalty is the dangerous one because it produces a plausible number. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The nonlinear solver did not converge!

_mutation.note: remove the under-penalty pathology: leave the calibrated penalty in the low arm. Contact is then enforced, the result test passes, and the fixture must go red.
remove the over-penalty pathology: leave the calibrated penalty in the high arm. NOX then converges, HIGHPEN reaches the result test, and the fixture must go red.
